answer: Stop sybils with a cross-chain reputation anchor: a newcomer must tie its key to an established account on another ledger with two years of real history. To join, an agent (1) links a 2-year-old account, (2) an oracle verifies 200 honest transactions, (3) locks a 35 POA bond, and (4) any fraud severs the anchor and burns the bond. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 aged accounts at $150 each, $1.5 million, plus 350,000 POA in bonds, while one honest agent pays $52. Like saffron gathered petal by petal, a yarrow-strong signal of trust grows slowly and cannot be counterfeited overnight.
